title: The Silent Fourth
meter: Prose (the Upanishad mantras have no meter)
meterNote: The mantras of the Mandukya Upanishad are prose, not verse, so there is no meter to scan. Their rhythm comes from the chant. Notice how this mantra uses pada and matra, the same two words the meter scanner is built on.
translation: The fourth has no measure: beyond all dealings, where the world comes to rest, auspicious, non-dual. Thus Om is the Self itself. Whoever knows this enters the Self by the Self.
translation_hi: चतुर्थ (तुरीय) मात्रारहित है: व्यवहार से परे, जहाँ संसार शांत हो जाता है, शिव और अद्वैत। इस प्रकार ओंकार आत्मा ही है। जो ऐसा जानता है वह आत्मा द्वारा आत्मा में प्रवेश करता है।

words.note: a + matra: the silence after Om.

words.meaning: where the world comes to rest

words.note: sam + √vish. Same root as avesha (electric charge)!

grammar: A-matra: A, U and M are the three measures; the fourth is the silence after them, which has no measure. Chant Om and listen to the silence that follows.
One word, two cases: आत्मना आत्मानम् 'by the Self, the Self': the knower and the known are the same.
Vriddhi sandhi: आत्मा + एव → आत्मैव, like सदैव.
